faqs.q: Where can I find information about current fires and incidents?
faqs.a: You can check the Current Fires and Incidents Map on the NSW Rural Fire Service website.

faqs.q: How do I check for major fire updates and warnings?
faqs.a: Visit the Alerts and warnings section of the NSW Rural Fire Service website for the latest major fire updates.

faqs.q: What information is available regarding fire danger ratings and total fire bans?
faqs.a: The NSW Rural Fire Service provides information on fire danger ratings and total fire bans.

faqs.q: How can I volunteer with the Rural Fire Service?
faqs.a: Information on volunteering with the NSW Rural Fire Service is available on their website.
